relationships.subject: MG53
relationships.evidence_quote: Our study demonstrated that MG53 improved neuropathic pain, neuroinflammation, and oxidative stress via activation of the Nrf2/HO-1 signaling pathway in the spinal cord of CCI model rats

relationships.subject: MG53
relationships.evidence_quote: intrathecal injection with rhMG53 protein notably alleviated CCI-induced mechanical allodynia, thermal hyperalgesia, neuroinflammation，oxidative stress and the increased level of reactive oxygen species (ROS)

key_findings: Spinal MG53 rose after CCI; intrathecal rhMG53 relieved allodynia, neuroinflammation and oxidative stress via Nrf2/HO-1.
